title: Mashgiach's Granddaughter Weds
body: Rav Binyomin Finkel's first granddaughter married in Modi'in Illit, drawing a crowd of rabbonim and community figures. The kallah is a daughter of Rav Moshe Finkel, son of the mashgiach and son-in-law of Rav Eliezer Lieberman.

title: Security Scandal Rocks Givat Ze'ev
body: Police in Yerushalayim arrested 7 private security guards in Givat Ze'ev on suspicion of helping smuggle in illegal Palestinian residents for cash.
